claim: Try the bundled sample without touching your project directory.
sandbox: Runs s3dir demo with a fresh temporary directory and verifies the bundled objects and health endpoint.

claim: Stores S3 objects as ordinary files in the selected directory.
sandbox: Starts a fresh server, writes an object through S3, and reads the mapped file from disk.

claim: Supports the documented local S3 workflow for objects, multipart uploads, byte ranges, metadata, and tags.
where: Landing Local S3 workflow section, README
sandbox: Uses a fresh endpoint to complete multipart upload and verify range, tag, and build-health behavior.

claim: Allows 300 requests per client every 60 seconds, then returns 429 with Retry-After.
sandbox: Makes the first 301 requests from one fresh client and checks the final response.

claim: Includes a browser console at the local /ui endpoint.
sandbox: Loads the console at 390px from a fresh local server and checks its reachable heading and touch target.

claim: The documentation site makes no third-party runtime requests.
where: Landing privacy fact, Privacy page, README
sandbox: Records every browser request while loading the built landing page and permits only its local origin.

claim: Public documentation pages reload offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Uses a fresh browser context, activates the service worker, goes offline, and reloads Privacy.

claim: Rejects object paths outside the selected directory.
sandbox: Attempts an encoded traversal write against a fresh server and checks that no outside file exists.

claim: Sends object events only to a webhook URL you explicitly configure.
where: README Privacy and static documentation, Privacy page
sandbox: Configures a fresh local webhook receiver, writes one object, and asserts that it receives one event.

claim: The supplied Compose image makes a fresh /data bind mount writable before running s3dir unprivileged.
sandbox: Checks the shipped image entrypoint contract: chown occurs before su-exec drops to the s3dir user.
